page.layout: One column of names, left of centre, with years in the left margin beside the first line of each group. Two margin notes on the right: the upper one beside 1548 to 1549, the lower one beside 1550 to 1551. A signature mark at the foot.

p.note: Diploma à Carolo V de usu Amasi Groninganis datum Augustę in comitiis, ubi tū cudebatur INTERIM.
GRONINGA sacramentum praestitit PHILIPPO II Hisp. regi. Edictum alterum Caroli V pro Groninganis ad omnes Belg. ordines contra ordines Frif. Orient, de portorio & usu Amasi.

page.notes: The years 1548 to 1554 stand in the left margin, each beside the first name of its group. The right margin notes are placed at the lines they stand beside. "Albert Jar[?], es." is uncertain: the scan shows a long-s-like letter after "Jar" and the word is hard to read. "Frif." in the second note is as printed and not certain. The "v" after Carolo and Caroli is read as a Roman V and is not certain. The printed signature mark "[*]" with "5" is at the foot.
